chapter: The Second Herd and its sidemen
title: Black musicians in the band: Royal, Ammons, Jackson, Pettiford
summary: Wong lists black musicians who played with the band; Herman says there was a lot of coming and going.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: You had some black musicians in your group -- Ernie Royal, Gene Ammons.
Milt Jackson, for a short time.
Yeah, Milt was with me quite a long time, and Oscar Pettiford. And then later I had a lot of -- who would come through the band for short periods, yeah.
Was this during times when World War II, mainly, people were going in and out of the service and --
Right, there was a lot of movement, a lot of movement, yeah. I had one very fantastic experience that I think should be related.
